name: Higher Drops - more ore per rock
author: Anders
description: Ore rocks drop more pieces. Coal 6-14 (was 3-8), Copper 2-3 (was 1), Iron 3-8 (was 1), Gold 2-4, Salt 2-3, Verdite 2-4, Green Crystal 2-5, Void Crystal 2-3, and the dense versions scale up to match. Stone, magic crystals and gem nodes are unchanged. Edit the DROPS table in js/plugins/HigherDrops.js.
